[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
William Glasgow married Sophia Hannah Taylor on 31 May 1849 at Delhi. Both index entries refer to the same marriage. One names William Glasgow as the groom’s father.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9901/records/401354 Ancestry, India, Select Marriages, 1792–1948: William Glasgow and Sophia Hannah Taylor, 31 May 1849, record 9901/401354].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9901/records/450377 Ancestry, India, Select Marriages, 1792–1948: William Glasgow and Sophia Hannah Taylor, 31 May 1849, record 9901/450377].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The 1853 Barrackpore baptism names William Glasgow and Sophia Hannah as the parents of William Henry Frederick Glasgow. Their names agree with the couple in the 1849 marriage. The William born at Barrackpore in 1825 is a possible match for this groom: his age fits and his father was also William. Neither index directly identifies the two as the same man.
[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/615954 Baptism, 1853]; [https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/1271490 Birth and baptism, 1825–26].
